instructions: Tools that control a running AutoCAD 2025-2027 through the AcadMcpBridge plugin. If a tool says the bridge is not reachable, ask the user to press Start on the AI companion panel (Home tab) in AutoCAD or to type MCPSTART. Coordinates are [x, y, z] in drawing units (WCS); see get_document_info for the units. Every changing tool call is one step for the undo tool.

tools.name: health_check
tools.description:
Check that AutoCAD is running with the MCP bridge started.

Returns plugin version, AutoCAD product and build, .NET version, port and
number of available routes. Answers even while AutoCAD is busy.

tools.name: get_document_info
tools.description:
Summary of the active drawing in AutoCAD.

Returns file name and path, unsaved changes, read-only flag, DWG version,
units (INSUNITS, metric/imperial), drawing extents, current layer, space and
layout, counts of model-space entities / layers / block definitions /
paper layouts, the command in progress (if any) and the number of open drawings.

tools.name: find_entities
tools.description:
Find entities in the active drawing by type, layer, block name, area, space and text.

All filters combine with AND. Returns {total, offset, count, has_more, items}; each item has
handle, type, layer, color, linetype, lineweight, space (Model / layout name), block (for
block references) and bounds {min, max}. Use the handle to address the entity in other tools.
Read-only.

types.description: DXF type names, e.g. "LINE", ["LWPOLYLINE", "INSERT"]. Aliases: "TABLE" (AutoCAD tables, ACAD_TABLE), "BLOCK" (block references, INSERT), "POLYLINE" (LWPOLYLINE + POLYLINE), "TEXT_ANY" (TEXT + MTEXT).

blocks.description: Block names for block references (dynamic blocks by definition name); wildcards allowed.

window.description: Area in XY: {"min": [x, y], "max": [x, y], "mode": "inside" | "crossing"}. "inside" (default) = entirely inside, "crossing" = touches the area.

text.description: Text pattern, * and ? wildcards, case-insensitive; use *word* to search for a substring. Matches TEXT/MTEXT content, block attribute values, dimension text overrides and AutoCAD table cells; other types never match.

tools.name: get_entity_properties
tools.description:
Full properties of entities by handle.

Common: handle, type, layer, color, linetype, lineweight, space, bounds, visible, transparency.
Plus per type: LINE start/end/length/angle; CIRCLE center/radius/area; ARC angles/length;
LWPOLYLINE vertices (with bulges, widths), closed, length, area; TEXT/MTEXT text, position,
height, rotation, style (MTEXT also raw "contents" with formatting codes); INSERT block,
position, rotation, scale, attributes [{tag, value}], dynamic block properties; DIMENSION
measurement and text override; HATCH pattern/area; ACAD_TABLE size and style (cell contents:
get_table). An unknown handle gives an item with "error" instead of failing the whole call.

handles.description: Entity handles from find_entities or get_selection.

tools.name: get_selection
tools.description:
Objects the user has selected in AutoCAD right now (selected before calling, with grips shown).

Returns {total, count, has_more, items} with the same entity summary as find_entities.
Use it when the user says "this", "these objects", "the selected table".

tools.name: get_system_variable
tools.description: Read AutoCAD system variables. Returns {values: {NAME: value}}; unknown names get {"error": ...}.

tools.name: list_documents
tools.description:
Drawings open in AutoCAD: name, path (null if never saved), active, read_only, has_unsaved_changes.
All other tools work on the active drawing; switch with set_active_document.

tools.name: new_document
tools.description:
Create a new drawing from a template and make it the active drawing.

template: a .dwt file name from AutoCAD's template folder (e.g. 'acadiso.dwt', 'acad') or a full path;
default: the QNEW template from AutoCAD's options, else acadiso.dwt / acad.dwt. An unknown name returns
the list of available templates. The new drawing is unnamed until saved. Not an undo step.

template.description: Template file name or full path to a .dwt.

tools.name: open_document
tools.description:
Open a drawing file (.dwg, .dxf, .dwt) and make it the active drawing.

path must be a full path. If the drawing is already open it is only made active (already_open: true).
A file in use by another program or user is refused (file_in_use) unless read_only is true. Opening a file
may close AutoCAD's untouched startup drawing (AutoCAD's own behavior). Not an undo step.

read_only.description: Open read-only: nothing can be changed or saved.

tools.name: set_active_document
tools.description:
Make another open drawing the active one; all other tools then work on it. Give name or path
(see list_documents). Returns the drawing's name, path, read_only and has_unsaved_changes.

name.description: File name of an open drawing, e.g. 'Plan.dwg' or 'Plan' (see list_documents).

path.description: Full path of an open drawing (when two open drawings share a name).

tools.name: close_document
tools.description:
Close an open drawing (default: the active one).

A drawing with unsaved changes is closed only with save: true (saves to its own file; a never-saved
drawing needs save_as first) or discard_changes: true (the changes are lost). Ask the user before
discarding changes. Returns which drawing is active afterwards. Cannot be undone.

name.description: File name of an open drawing, e.g. 'Plan.dwg' or 'Plan' (see list_documents).

path.description: Full path of an open drawing (when two open drawings share a name).

save.description: Save to the drawing's own file before closing.

discard_changes.description: Close without saving; unsaved changes are lost.

tools.name: save_document
tools.description:
Save the active drawing to its own file (like QSAVE). A never-saved drawing needs save_as;
a read-only drawing cannot be saved (save_as a copy instead). Not an undo step.

tools.name: save_as
tools.description:
Save the active drawing under a new full path (.dwg or .dxf) and format; the drawing then continues
under the new name, like SAVEAS (previous_path tells the old one).

An existing file is replaced only with overwrite: true (ask the user first); a file open in AutoCAD
or in use elsewhere is refused. The folder must exist. Not an undo step.

path.description: Full path ending with .dwg or .dxf, e.g. C:\Projects\plan_v2.dwg.

format.description: DWG/DXF version: 2018 (current, read by AutoCAD 2018-2027) or an older one for older programs.

tools.name: plot_to_pdf
tools.description:
Print layouts of the active drawing to PDF (AutoCAD's 'DWG To PDF.pc3').

layouts: names (see list_layouts), '*' for all paper layouts in tab order; default: the current layout.
One multi-page PDF at path (.pdf), or with separate_files: true one PDF per layout in the folder path,
named <drawing>-<layout>.pdf. An existing PDF is replaced only with overwrite: true.

Paper layouts print with their own page setup (paper size, scale, plot style, rotation); only the
printer is replaced, with the PDF paper closest to the layout's. Model prints the extents (or a
window p1-p2) fitted to the paper, or at 'scale', on a sheet turned to suit the area. paper overrides
the size: 'A3', 'A1' … (ISO full bleed) or a full PDF paper name. Printing a layout that was never
opened sets it up as clicking its tab would (AutoCAD creates its default viewport). The user's current
layout is restored. Can take a while for many sheets. Not an undo step. Returns the files and, per
sheet, the paper, area and scale used.

path.description: Full path of the PDF (or of the folder, with separate_files).

layouts.description: Layout name(s), 'Model', or '*' for all paper layouts. Default: the current layout.

separate_files.description: One PDF per layout; path is then a folder.

paper.description: Paper size for all sheets: 'A4', 'A3', 'A1' … or a full PDF paper name. Default: the layout's own size.

plot_style.description: Plot style table, e.g. 'monochrome.ctb'. Default: the layout's own.

area.description: Model only: extents (default), window (p1, p2) or page_setup (Model's saved settings).

p2.description: Model only: opposite window corner [x, y].

scale.description: Model only: drawing units per paper millimetre, e.g. 100 for 1:100 in a drawing in mm. Default: fit to paper.

tools.name: attach_xref
tools.description:
Attach another DWG as an external reference (xref) and insert it into the current space of the
active drawing (model or the current layout).

path: full path of the .dwg. name defaults to the file name. overlay: true attaches as an overlay
(not seen by drawings that reference this one). path_type: relative (default when this drawing is
saved; same drive only) or full. Returns the xref name, stored path, status and the handle of the
inserted reference. One undo step.

path.description: Full path of the DWG to reference.

name.description: Xref (block) name. Default: the file name without extension.

overlay.description: Attach as overlay instead of attachment.

path_type.description: How the path is stored. Default: relative if the drawing is saved, else full.

layer.description: Existing layer name. Default: the current layer.

tools.name: manage_xrefs

names.description: Xref name(s) or '*' for all top-level references.

path.description: repath only: full path of the new DWG.

tools.name: purge
tools.description:
Remove unused named objects from the active drawing (like PURGE): layers, linetypes, block definitions,
text / dimension / table / multileader styles, registered applications. Repeats until nothing more is
unused (a removed block can free its layers and nested blocks).

dry_run is true by default: it lists exactly what would be removed and changes nothing. Show the list
to the user, then call again with dry_run: false. Layer 0, Defpoints, current layer and styles,
Standard styles, Continuous and xref-dependent objects are never removed. One undo step.

kinds.description: What to purge. Default: all kinds.

names.description: Name mask with * and ?, e.g. 'TMP_*'. Default: all names.

dry_run.description: Only list what would be removed (default). false purges.

tools.name: audit
tools.description:
Check the active drawing for database errors (like AUDIT). fix: true also repairs them; repairs
cannot be undone with the undo tool, so ask the user first. For a saved drawing returns
errors_found, errors_fixed, objects_erased and the report text; an unsaved drawing gets no report
(AutoCAD writes it next to the file).

tools.name: import_from_drawing
tools.description:
Copy definitions from another DWG or a template (DWT) into the active drawing: layers, linetypes,
text / dimension / table / multileader styles, block definitions. Use it to bring a layer standard
or company styles from a template. The source file is only read (it may be open in AutoCAD).

on_conflict: skip (default) keeps definitions that already exist here; replace overwrites them with
the source's (ask the user first; replacing a block redefines all its insertions). What the imported
objects need comes along (a layer's linetype, a style's text style) and is listed in also_added.
One undo step.

path.description: Full path of the source .dwg or .dwt.

names.description: Name mask with * and ?, e.g. 'E-*'. Default: all.

on_conflict.description: When a definition with the same name exists here.

tools.name: list_layers
tools.description:
Layers of the active drawing: name, color, linetype, lineweight, on, frozen, locked,
plottable, current, from_xref, description and the number of entities on each.

name.description: Layer name filter with * and ? wildcards.

with_counts.description: Count entities per layer (model space and layouts).

tools.name: list_blocks
tools.description:
Block definitions: name, dynamic, references (number of insertions, dynamic blocks included),
entities, attribute definitions [{tag, prompt, default, constant, invisible}], origin, units.

name.description: Block name filter with * and ? wildcards.

tools.name: list_layouts
tools.description:
Model and paper layouts in tab order: name, current, entities, viewports, plot device,
paper size, plot style table and rotation.

tools.name: list_xrefs
tools.description:
External references: name, saved path, status (Resolved, Unloaded, FileNotFound, ...),
overlay or attachment, nested, number of references.

tools.name: list_styles
tools.description:
Named styles of the drawing with the current one marked. Text styles include font,
height, width factor and oblique angle; dimension styles text height, arrow size, scale.

kinds.description: Which styles: any of "text", "dimension", "table", "multileader", "linetype". Default: all.

tools.name: zoom
tools.description:
Zoom the AutoCAD view: to the drawing extents, to a window, or to chosen objects.

Changes only what the user sees, never the drawing; the undo tool does not count it.
Works in the current space: model space, a layout, or the model space of the active viewport.
Objects in another layout are refused - switch there first with set_current_layout.
Returns the layout, space and the new visible window (view_center, view_width, view_height).

mode.description: extents = all visible objects of the current space (layers off/frozen skipped); window = the box p1-p2; entities = the objects given by handles or filter. Default: entities if handles/filter are given, window if p1 is given, otherwise extents.

p1.description: mode window: one corner [x, y] or [x, y, z] (WCS).

handles.description: mode entities: handles of the objects to show. Use this OR filter.

filter.description: mode entities: find_entities keys (types, layers, blocks, window, text). Without 'space' only objects of the current space are used.

padding.description: Margin around the zoomed area as a share of its size on each side (0-1).

tools.name: set_current_layout
tools.description:
Make a layout current in AutoCAD: 'Model' for model space or a paper layout name (see list_layouts).

Changes only what the user sees, not the drawing content; the undo tool skips it (undoing a
later change may switch the layout back). Returns the new layout and space,
the visible window and previous_layout (to switch back when done, if the user wants).

name.description: Layout name as in list_layouts, or 'Model'. Case-insensitive.

tools.name: capture_view
tools.description:
Take a picture (PNG) of the drawing to look at it: the current view, all objects, a window or chosen objects.

The picture is rendered off-screen: the user's view in AutoCAD does not move (use zoom to change it).
It shows the current space (model space, a layout, or the model space of the active viewport) with the
current view direction. Returns the image plus layout, space, image size and drawing_units_per_pixel
(to estimate coordinates from the picture). Use it to check layouts of new objects, overlaps of texts
and dimensions, or to understand an unknown drawing.

mode.description: current = what the user sees now; extents = all visible objects of the current space; window = the box p1-p2; entities = the objects given by handles or filter. Default: entities if handles/filter are given, window if p1 is given, otherwise current.

p1.description: mode window: one corner [x, y] or [x, y, z] (WCS).

handles.description: mode entities: handles of the objects to show. Use this OR filter.

filter.description: mode entities: find_entities keys (types, layers, blocks, window, text). Without 'space' only objects of the current space are used.

padding.description: Margin around the area as a share of its size on each side (0-1). Not used in mode current.

size.description: Length of the longer image side in pixels (100-4000). The other side follows the area's proportions.

background.description: dark (like AutoCAD model space) or light (white, like paper).

save_path.description: Also save the PNG to this full path (folder must exist), e.g. for a report. Only when the user wants a file.

tools.name: get_table
tools.description:
Read the contents of an AutoCAD table (ACAD_TABLE).

Returns rows/columns count, range read, cells as a 2D array [row][column] (0-based; row 0 is
usually the title, row 1 the header; see row_styles: _TITLE/_HEADER/_DATA), row_heights,
column_widths, merged ranges [top, left, bottom, right] (only the top-left cell of a merged
range has the value, the others are null), formulas [{row, column, formula, value}],
locked_cells (content locked or read-only, e.g. linked to Excel: they cannot be written),
block_cells (block name and attribute values), data_links and, if the user has selected
cells inside the table, selected_cells. Tables over 5000 cells are returned in parts:
"truncated" is true and "hint" says which rows to read next.

handle.description: Handle of the AutoCAD table (find_entities types=TABLE). Omit to use the one table the user has selected, or the only table in the drawing.

format.description: "plain" (default): displayed text without formatting codes; "raw": text with MTEXT formatting codes; "value": typed values (numbers stay numbers).

details.description: Return each cell as an object {value, formula, locked, linked, merged_into, data_type}.

tools.name: extract_block_attributes
tools.description:
Attribute values of block references as a table, e.g. for a schedule or an Excel export.

Returns {total, offset, count, has_more, columns, rows}: columns are handle, block, space,
layer, position and then one column per attribute tag; rows hold the values (null when a
block has no such tag). Read-only.

blocks.description: Block names, wildcards allowed. Default: all blocks with attributes.

tags.description: Only these attribute tags (columns). Default: all tags found.

tools.name: set_table_cells
tools.description:
Fill cells of an AutoCAD table.

Values: text (MTEXT codes kept), numbers, "=formula" (e.g. "=Sum(B3:B5)"; columns are
letters, rows 1-based as AutoCAD shows them), or null to clear. Inside a merged range write to
its top-left cell. Locked cells (also cells linked to Excel) are never written: the call fails
with cell_locked, nothing changes, and the user must unlock them in AutoCAD first. Cells with
blocks are not overwritten. Read the table with get_table first. One undo step.

handle.description: Table handle (find_entities types=TABLE). Omit to use the one table the user has selected, or the only table in the drawing.

values.description: A block of values [[row1...], [row2...]] written from 'start'. Use instead of cells.

start.description: [row, column] of the top-left cell for 'values'. Omit to start at the cells the user has selected in the table.

add_rows.description: Append rows (copying the last row's format) when values run past the end.

tools.name: modify_table
tools.description:
Change the structure of an AutoCAD table: insert or delete rows and columns (new ones copy
the format of their neighbour), merge or unmerge cells, set column widths and row heights.
Deleting rows/columns with locked cells is refused. One undo step.

handle.description: Table handle (find_entities types=TABLE). Omit to use the one table the user has selected, or the only table in the drawing.

at.description: Row/column index (0-based). insert: new rows/columns go before it; = row/column count appends.

tools.name: create_table
tools.description:
Create an AutoCAD table from data, e.g. an equipment schedule. Values follow the rules of
set_table_cells (text, numbers, "=formula"). Returns the handle, size and bounds. One undo step.

data.description: Rows of cell values; the first row is the header when header is true.

title.description: Title row above the data, merged across all columns.

header.description: Format the first data row as the header.

column_widths.description: One width for all columns or one per column.

style.description: Table style name (list_styles). Default: the current style.

text_style.description: Text style for all cells (override of the table style).

text_height.description: Text height for all cells (override); rows grow to fit. Better: a table style with the right heights (set_table_style).

layer.description: Existing layer name. Default: the current layer.

color.description: "ByLayer", "ByBlock", an ACI index 1-255 or "#RRGGBB". Default: ByLayer.

linetype.description: Linetype name, "ByLayer" or "ByBlock"; loaded from acadiso.lin/acad.lin if missing. Default: ByLayer.

tools.name: create_line
tools.description:
Draw a line from start to end in the current space (model space or the active layout).

Returns the new entity (handle, type, layer, color, bounds) and its length.
The call is one step for the undo tool.

start.description: [x, y] or [x, y, z] in WCS drawing units

end.description: [x, y] or [x, y, z] in WCS drawing units

layer.description: Existing layer name. Default: the current layer.

color.description: "ByLayer", "ByBlock", an ACI index 1-255 or "#RRGGBB". Default: ByLayer.

linetype.description: Linetype name, "ByLayer" or "ByBlock"; loaded from acadiso.lin/acad.lin if missing. Default: ByLayer.

tools.name: create_polyline
tools.description:
Draw a 2D polyline (LWPOLYLINE), optionally closed and with arc segments.
Returns the new entity with vertices, length and area (if closed). One undo step.

bulges.description: One bulge per vertex for the segment that starts there: 0 = straight, 1 = half circle counter-clockwise, -1 = clockwise, tan(angle/4) in general.

layer.description: Existing layer name. Default: the current layer.

color.description: "ByLayer", "ByBlock", an ACI index 1-255 or "#RRGGBB". Default: ByLayer.

linetype.description: Linetype name, "ByLayer" or "ByBlock"; loaded from acadiso.lin/acad.lin if missing. Default: ByLayer.

tools.name: create_circle
tools.description: Draw a circle. One undo step.

center.description: [x, y] or [x, y, z] in WCS drawing units

layer.description: Existing layer name. Default: the current layer.

color.description: "ByLayer", "ByBlock", an ACI index 1-255 or "#RRGGBB". Default: ByLayer.

linetype.description: Linetype name, "ByLayer" or "ByBlock"; loaded from acadiso.lin/acad.lin if missing. Default: ByLayer.

tools.name: create_arc
tools.description: Draw an arc from center + radius + start/end angles, or through three points. One undo step.

start_angle_deg.description: 0 = +X axis; the arc runs counter-clockwise to end_angle_deg.

points.description: Or three points [start, middle, end] on the arc.

layer.description: Existing layer name. Default: the current layer.

color.description: "ByLayer", "ByBlock", an ACI index 1-255 or "#RRGGBB". Default: ByLayer.

linetype.description: Linetype name, "ByLayer" or "ByBlock"; loaded from acadiso.lin/acad.lin if missing. Default: ByLayer.

tools.name: create_text
tools.description: Single-line text (TEXT). For several lines or formatting use create_mtext. One undo step.

position.description: [x, y] or [x, y, z] in WCS drawing units

height.description: Text height in drawing units. Default: TEXTSIZE.

justify.description: Which point of the text sits at position: BaseLeft (default), BaseCenter, BaseRight, TopLeft, TopCenter, TopRight, MiddleLeft, MiddleCenter, MiddleRight, BottomLeft, BottomCenter, BottomRight.

style.description: Text style name (list_styles). Default: the current style.

layer.description: Existing layer name. Default: the current layer.

color.description: "ByLayer", "ByBlock", an ACI index 1-255 or "#RRGGBB". Default: ByLayer.

linetype.description: Linetype name, "ByLayer" or "ByBlock"; loaded from acadiso.lin/acad.lin if missing. Default: ByLayer.

tools.name: create_mtext
tools.description: Multiline text (MTEXT). One undo step.

text.description: Text; line breaks become paragraphs. MTEXT codes (\P, {\fArial;...}) are kept.

position.description: [x, y] or [x, y, z] in WCS drawing units

height.description: Text height in drawing units. Default: TEXTSIZE.

attachment.description: Which point sits at position: TopLeft (default), MiddleCenter, BottomRight, ...

style.description: Text style name (list_styles). Default: the current style.

layer.description: Existing layer name. Default: the current layer.

color.description: "ByLayer", "ByBlock", an ACI index 1-255 or "#RRGGBB". Default: ByLayer.

linetype.description: Linetype name, "ByLayer" or "ByBlock"; loaded from acadiso.lin/acad.lin if missing. Default: ByLayer.

tools.name: create_dimension
tools.description:
Create a linear or aligned dimension. Returns it with the measurement and its effective appearance
(text_height, arrow_size, dim_scale, …). One undo step.

Without 'style' it uses the current dimension style WITH the current DIM* system variable overrides
(DIMTXT, DIMASZ, DIMBLK, …), like the DIMLINEAR command. text_height, arrow_size, arrow, text_style,
decimals, dim_scale, fit and text_position override the style for this dimension only. For many
dimensions of one look, prefer a dimension style (or dim_scale) over per-object overrides.

dim_line_point.description: A point the dimension line passes through.

kind.description: "aligned" (parallel to p1-p2, default) or "linear" (horizontal by default, see angle_deg).

angle_deg.description: linear: dimension line angle; 0 = horizontal, 90 = vertical.

text_override.description: Replace the measured text; "<>" stands for the measurement.

style.description: Dimension style name. Default: the current style.

text_height.description: Text height (DIMTXT) for this dimension, in drawing units before dim_scale.

arrow.description: Arrowhead: closed_filled (default), _ARCHTICK, _OBLIQUE, _DOT, _DOTSMALL, _OPEN, _OPEN30, _OPEN90, _CLOSED, _CLOSEDBLANK, _NONE, _INTEGRAL, or a block name.

dim_scale.description: Overall scale (DIMSCALE): multiplies text height, arrow size, gaps and extensions.

fit.description: Where text and arrows go when they do not fit between the extension lines: best (AutoCAD default), arrows (arrows outside first), text (text outside first), both_outside, text_inside (always keep text inside).

text_position.description: Put the text at this point [x, y] (WCS); the dimension line stays.

text_leader.description: With text_position: draw a leader from the moved text to the dimension line.

layer.description: Existing layer name. Default: the current layer.

color.description: "ByLayer", "ByBlock", an ACI index 1-255 or "#RRGGBB". Default: ByLayer.

linetype.description: Linetype name, "ByLayer" or "ByBlock"; loaded from acadiso.lin/acad.lin if missing. Default: ByLayer.

tools.name: modify_dimension
tools.description:
Change existing dimensions without re-creating them: text, text position, text height, arrows, text style,
decimals, overall scale, fit, or the dimension style. Returns the new effective appearance of each.

Objects are chosen by handles or by filter (types: DIMENSION…); all must be dimensions, otherwise
nothing changes. text_position works on one dimension per call. 'style' switches the style and drops
earlier overrides; reset_overrides drops them while keeping the style. One call = one undo step.

handles.description: Entity handles to act on (from find_entities / get_selection). Use this OR filter.

filter.description: Select the objects by a filter instead of handles: the find_entities keys (types, layers, blocks, window, space, text). A filter needs confirm: true; run with dry_run: true first to see what it hits.

text_override.description: New text; "<>" stands for the measurement, "" restores the measured text.

style.description: Switch to this dimension style (earlier overrides are dropped first).

reset_overrides.description: Drop the object's overrides: take all values from its style again (applied before the other changes).

text_height.description: Text height (DIMTXT) for this dimension, in drawing units before dim_scale.

arrow.description: Arrowhead: closed_filled (default), _ARCHTICK, _OBLIQUE, _DOT, _DOTSMALL, _OPEN, _OPEN30, _OPEN90, _CLOSED, _CLOSEDBLANK, _NONE, _INTEGRAL, or a block name.

dim_scale.description: Overall scale (DIMSCALE): multiplies text height, arrow size, gaps and extensions.

fit.description: Where text and arrows go when they do not fit between the extension lines: best (AutoCAD default), arrows (arrows outside first), text (text outside first), both_outside, text_inside (always keep text inside).

text_position.description: Put the text at this point [x, y] (WCS); the dimension line stays.

text_leader.description: With text_position: draw a leader from the moved text to the dimension line.

dry_run.description: Change nothing; report how many and which objects would be affected.

confirm.description: Required when objects are chosen by filter. Ask the user before bulk changes.

tools.name: create_mleader
tools.description:
Create a multileader (MLEADER) with text: an arrow pointing at something and a label.

points go from the arrow tip to the point near the text, e.g. [[1000, 500], [1800, 1200]]; the text is
placed next to the last point (on the side the leader points to) unless text_position is given.
extra_leaders adds more arrows to the same label. Arrow, text style and height, landing come from the
multileader style (set_mleader_style). Returns the new multileader. One undo step.

points.description: Leader points: arrow tip first, the point near the text last (at least 2).

text_position.description: Where to put the text [x, y]; default: next to the last point.

extra_leaders.description: More leaders to the same text, each a point list like 'points'.

style.description: Multileader style name. Default: the current one.

text_height.description: Text height override. Default: from the style.

layer.description: Existing layer name. Default: the current layer.

color.description: "ByLayer", "ByBlock", an ACI index 1-255 or "#RRGGBB". Default: ByLayer.

linetype.description: Linetype name, "ByLayer" or "ByBlock"; loaded from acadiso.lin/acad.lin if missing. Default: ByLayer.

tools.name: insert_block
tools.description:
Insert a block reference with attribute values and dynamic properties.
Unknown tags or properties are refused with the list of valid ones. One undo step.

position.description: [x, y] or [x, y, z] in WCS drawing units

scale.description: Uniform factor or [x, y] / [x, y, z].

attributes.description: {TAG: value}; tags not given get their default values.

layer.description: Existing layer name. Default: the current layer.

color.description: "ByLayer", "ByBlock", an ACI index 1-255 or "#RRGGBB". Default: ByLayer.

linetype.description: Linetype name, "ByLayer" or "ByBlock"; loaded from acadiso.lin/acad.lin if missing. Default: ByLayer.

tools.name: update_block_attributes
tools.description:
Change attribute values of block references, e.g. fill a schedule from user data.

Returns {blocks, attributes_changed} and lists tags that some blocks do not have.
Blocks on locked layers make the call fail. One undo step.

values.description: {TAG: value} applied to every chosen block (with handles or filter).

handles.description: Entity handles to act on (from find_entities / get_selection). Use this OR filter.

filter.description: Select the objects by a filter instead of handles: the find_entities keys (types, layers, blocks, window, space, text). A filter needs confirm: true; run with dry_run: true first to see what it hits.

updates.description: Different values per block: [{"handle": "2A", "values": {"NAME": "P-1"}}, ...]. Use instead of values + handles/filter.

dry_run.description: Change nothing; report how many and which objects would be affected.

confirm.description: Required when objects are chosen by filter. Ask the user before bulk changes.

tools.name: undo
tools.description:
Revert the last change(s) made through these tools, using AutoCAD's UNDO.

Each changing tool call is exactly one undo step. Refuses if the user has run any command in
AutoCAD since the last MCP change, so the user's own work is never undone; in that case ask
the user to use UNDO in AutoCAD. Returns {undone, remaining_mcp_changes}.

steps.description: How many MCP changes to revert.

tools.name: set_entity_properties
tools.description:
Change layer, color, linetype, lineweight, linetype scale, transparency, visibility or style of objects.

Objects are chosen by handles or by filter. Objects on locked layers make the whole call fail
(nothing changes); unlock the layer first. One call = one step for the undo tool.

Dynamic blocks: dynamic_properties changes parameters of block references already in the drawing
(e.g. {"Distance1": 3000, "Visibility1": "Open"}); the handle, attributes and XData stay. Names and
allowed values: get_entity_properties of the reference. All targets must be dynamic block references.

handles.description: Entity handles to act on (from find_entities / get_selection). Use this OR filter.

filter.description: Select the objects by a filter instead of handles: the find_entities keys (types, layers, blocks, window, space, text). A filter needs confirm: true; run with dry_run: true first to see what it hits.

color.description: "ByLayer", "ByBlock", an ACI index 1-255 or "#RRGGBB". Default: the current color (usually ByLayer).

linetype.description: Linetype name, "ByLayer" or "ByBlock"; loaded from acadiso.lin/acad.lin if missing.

style.description: Style by object type: texts/mtexts -> text style, dimensions -> dimension style (their overrides are dropped), tables -> table style (cell text style/height overrides dropped), multileaders -> multileader style.

dynamic_properties.description: Dynamic block parameters to set: {property name: value}, e.g. {"Distance1": 3000}. Numbers for distances/angles (angles in radians as AutoCAD stores them), text for lists and visibility states.

dry_run.description: Change nothing; report how many and which objects would be affected.

confirm.description: Required when objects are chosen by filter. Ask the user before bulk changes.

tools.name: transform_entities
tools.description:
Move, copy (also as a linear array), rotate, scale or mirror objects.

Returns {operation, affected} and, for copy and mirror with keep_original, created_handles.

Objects are chosen by handles or by filter. Objects on locked layers make the whole call fail
(nothing changes); unlock the layer first. One call = one step for the undo tool.

handles.description: Entity handles to act on (from find_entities / get_selection). Use this OR filter.

filter.description: Select the objects by a filter instead of handles: the find_entities keys (types, layers, blocks, window, space, text). A filter needs confirm: true; run with dry_run: true first to see what it hits.

vector.description: move/copy: displacement [dx, dy] or [dx, dy, dz] (or give from + to).

count.description: copy: number of copies, each one more displacement further (an array).

p1.description: mirror: first point of the mirror line.

p2.description: mirror: second point of the mirror line.

dry_run.description: Change nothing; report how many and which objects would be affected.

confirm.description: Required when objects are chosen by filter. Ask the user before bulk changes.

tools.name: delete_entities
tools.description:
Delete objects. Returns {deleted}. Ask the user before deleting objects they did not ask about.

Objects are chosen by handles or by filter. Objects on locked layers make the whole call fail
(nothing changes); unlock the layer first. One call = one step for the undo tool.

handles.description: Entity handles to act on (from find_entities / get_selection). Use this OR filter.

filter.description: Select the objects by a filter instead of handles: the find_entities keys (types, layers, blocks, window, space, text). A filter needs confirm: true; run with dry_run: true first to see what it hits.

dry_run.description: Change nothing; report how many and which objects would be affected.

confirm.description: Required when objects are chosen by filter. Ask the user before bulk changes.

tools.name: set_selection
tools.description:
Select objects in AutoCAD for the user (shows grips), e.g. to point at what was found.
Does not change the drawing.

handles.description: Objects to select with grips in AutoCAD; [] clears the selection.

tools.name: set_system_variable
tools.description:
Set an AutoCAD system variable. Returns {name, old, new}. Read-only variables are refused.
Counts as one undo step.

value.description: New value; type must fit the variable.

tools.name: set_text_style
tools.description:
Create or change a text style: font (TrueType family like "ISOCPEUR" / "Arial", or an SHX file like
"txt.shx", "gost.shx"), height, width factor, obliquing, current. Texts, dimensions, tables and
multileaders that use the style change with it. Returns the style. One undo step.

name.description: Style name. Created if it does not exist, otherwise changed.

font.description: TrueType family name or .ttf file, or an .shx file name. Required for a new style.

big_font.description: SHX big font file (Asian languages), e.g. bigfont.shx.

height.description: Fixed text height; 0 = height is set per text (usual for annotation styles).

current.description: Make it the current style for new objects.

tools.name: set_dim_style
tools.description:
Create or change a dimension style: text style and height, arrows, extension lines, text gap and
position, decimals, overall scale, fit. Dimensions using the style change with it (except their own
overrides - see modify_dimension). A new style copies based_on, or the current style with the current
DIM* overrides. current: true also clears the current DIM* overrides. Returns the style. One undo step.

name.description: Style name. Created if it does not exist, otherwise changed.

based_on.description: New style only: copy this dimension style (default: the current style with its overrides).

text_style.description: Text style name (create it with set_text_style).

ext_offset.description: DIMEXO: gap between the object and the extension line.

ext_extend.description: DIMEXE: extension line beyond the dimension line.

text_vertical.description: DIMTAD: centered, above, outside, jis or below.

dim_scale.description: DIMSCALE: overall scale (e.g. 100 for 1:100 in model space).

fit.description: best, arrows, text, both_outside or text_inside (see create_dimension).

current.description: Make it the current style for new objects.

tools.name: set_table_style
tools.description:
Create or change a table style: text style and text height of title / header / data rows, cell margins.
Tables using the style change with it, except cells with their own text style/height (set_entity_properties
with style drops those). Returns the style. One undo step.

name.description: Style name. Created if it does not exist, otherwise changed.

based_on.description: New style only: copy the settings of this table style first (default: Standard).

text_height.description: Text height: one number for all rows, or {"title": 350, "header": 250, "data": 250}.

current.description: Make it the current style for new objects.

tools.name: set_mleader_style
tools.description:
Create or change a multileader style: text style and height, arrowhead and size, landing gap, dogleg.
Returns the style. One undo step.

name.description: Style name. Created if it does not exist, otherwise changed.

based_on.description: New style only: copy the settings of this multileader style first (default: Standard).

landing_gap.description: Gap between the landing line and the text.

dogleg_length.description: Length of the horizontal landing; 0 = no landing.

current.description: Make it the current style for new objects.

tools.name: create_layer
tools.description: Create a new layer. Fails with already_exists if the name is taken (then use set_layer_state).

linetype.description: Linetype name; loaded from acadiso.lin/acad.lin if missing.

tools.name: set_layer_state
tools.description:
Turn layers on/off, freeze/thaw, lock/unlock, set plottable, color, linetype, lineweight,
description, make current or rename. Only the given settings change. The current layer
cannot be frozen. Returns the changed layers.
